title: Carpenter v. United States (2018)
key_points: Holding: Acquiring historical cell-site location records generally requires a warrant.
New Jersey: State v. Earls, 214 N.J. 564 (2013) already required a warrant for cell phone location information under the NJ Constitution.
officer_notes: Scenario: You want a suspect's location history for the past two weeks from his carrier.
Takeaway: Use a warrant for location history.
